name: M3_PMS130MI_LstOpenQI
description: List open quality inspection balance identities for a specific item and lot that are still under inspection. The operation belongs to receipt inspection for manufacturing orders and returns, for each matching balance identity, the item and lot together with warehouse, location, container, and key quality inspection references. These references include the LI specification number, sequence number, and the quality inspection request ID, which together show which quantities of a lot remain in inspection and how they are controlled.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number identifying which item's lot to list open quality inspections for.

inputParameters.name: BANO
inputParameters.description: Lot number identifying the specific lot whose open quality inspections should be listed.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number for the lot with open quality inspections.

outputParameters.name: BANO
outputParameters.description: Lot number for the lot with open quality inspections.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the inspected lot's balance ID is stored.

outputParameters.name: WHSL
outputParameters.description: Location within the warehouse where the inspected lot's balance ID is stored.

outputParameters.name: CAMU
outputParameters.description: Container number that forms part of the balance ID for the inspected lot.

outputParameters.name: ANNO
outputParameters.description: LI specification number used for the analysis specification applied to the inspected lot.

outputParameters.name: SEMO
outputParameters.description: Sequence number distinguishing different inspection reports for the same item, lot, and LI specification.

outputParameters.name: QRID
outputParameters.description: Unique identifier of the quality inspection (QI) request for the balance ID.
